Not a release: expect bugs. Report problems at https://github.com/VyneMC/Vyne/issues.

### Commit
Update: move Fabric API's calls into Vyne's typed hooks

Port every reflection patch-layer bridge to typed hooks in src/hooks:
fuel, sleep, items, enchantments, ingredients, payloads, menus,
block entity unload, interaction, pack defaults, dynamic registries,
datagen tags, screens, block-breaking continuation, sounds, fluids,
Indigo, render data, models, particles and block dust. Delete the old
mixins and helpers. Add a lambda: selector form, a block entity unload
fixture check, and notes on writing hooks.

### Commit
Phase 6 start: retarget moved hooks, typed Fabric API hooks

- Design: spot table and Vyne-owned hooks (unified-platform 4.1, 4.2)
- HookRetarget: a Fabric mod's call-site hook follows its call when
  NeoForge moved it within the class; replaces the known-packs and
  vanilla-language bridges
- fabricApiMojangJar: Fabric API with Mojang names for src/hooks
- FabricBlockBreakHook: block breaking as a typed Vyne hook; the
  reflection bridge is removed (same results in patch-layer)

### Commit
Run mixed packs on the patch layer; delete the compatibility path and stand-ins

- Every pack with NeoForge mods now runs on NeoForge's patched game; in
  mixed packs Fabric API runs on it through the patch layer, also on the
  NeoForge installer fallback (-Dvyne.hooks=false)
- Delete the compatibility path: hand-written NeoForge/Forge classes, VCL
  lifecycle, dynamic bridge engine, registry/event/fluid/capability/
  config/network bridges, runtime bytecode translation, 28 emulation
  mixins, and their build steps and tests
- NeoForge mods are remapped exactly once or the launch stops with an
  error; legacy Forge mods are skipped with a warning
- Download NeoForge's mergetool API (Dist, OnlyIn); Vyne's FML provides
  modlauncher's TransformingThrowablePatternConverter
- Compile against the real Minecraft jar with runtime names
  (./gradlew minecraftRuntimeJar) and delete every Minecraft stand-in
- Test mod uses the real FML API; docs and to-do updated

### Commit
bridge remaining Fabric API handlers into NeoForge patch layer

Finished wiring batches 3–6 plus the client-side handlers—all 60 entries in
the handler table are now replaced, with 0 disabled.

- Sleep: hook bed occupation, wake-up pos, and sleeping direction at
  NeoForge call sites (verified with both a fake player and a villager)
- Items: route CustomDamageHandler through damageItem and recipe
  remainders via getCraftingRemainingItem; wire supportsEnchantment /
  isPrimaryItemFor plus EnchantmentEvents.MODIFY inside NeoForge's
  registry lambda
- Recipes & data: support Fabric custom ingredients in NeoForge's
  ingredient and list codecs (trades and air checks already lined up);
  add known packs filter, vanilla lang file, and datagen tag replace
- Networking & UI: round-trip Fabric payloads through NeoForge's custom
  payload codecs and open extended menus via openMenu
- Client: verified targets against the patched client jar for screen
  tick/render events, Indigo chunk building, block entity render data,
  fluid sprites/overlays, sound streams, model modifiers, and block-break
  continuation
- Smoke test: add patch-layer test covering beds, items, durability,
  ingredients, payloads, and menus; add -Psmoke.xmx for server heap size

### Commit
Patch layer: run Fabric API on NeoForge's patched game (opt-in)

- fabricApiOnPatches checks every Fabric API injection against
  NeoForge's patched classes: 404 apply, 57 break (in 19 modules).
- A patch-layer table switches broken Fabric API handlers, or whole
  mixins, off on the patch layer and logs them as replaced or not
  available yet; all other Fabric API injections become optional there.
- Replaced on the patch layer: block breaking (PlayerBlockBreakEvents
  fired from NeoForge's patched code), tag removal (NeoForge's own),
  datapack registries (NeoForge's list merged with Fabric's dynamic
  registries). Fixed Fabric's Pack.parentsPredicate default missing
  after NeoForge's constructor change.
- -Dvyne.hooks.mixed=true runs mixed packs on the patch layer: the
  mixed test server reaches Done with 0 errors. Mixed packs still use
  the compatibility path by default.
- Smoke tests accept extra JVM flags with -Psmoke.jvmArgs.

### Commit
Run NeoForge-only packs on Vyne's patches by default

  - NeoForge-only packs use Vyne's binary patches instead of
  running
    NeoForge's installer at first start. -Dvyne.hooks=false, or
  patches
    missing from the jar, fall back to the installer.
  - NeoForge reports its real version (21.1.265) instead of
  0.0.0: the
    version is in Vyne's NeoForge jar manifest and registered by
  Vyne's
    FML.
  - Route FMLModContainer to VyneModContainer, so mods that check
  their
    container type (Comforts) load in NeoForge-only packs.
  - docs/dev/hook-layer.md describes the binary patch layer; the
  smoke
    tests' -Psmoke.installer forces the installer path.

Automatic development build from `dev-1.21.1` at 1dc509e6d2aac41bdfd9935647434cb991628b66.

Not a release: expect bugs. Report problems at https://github.com/VyneMC/Vyne/issues.

### Commit
Update to Fabric Loader 0.20.1 and NeoForge 21.1.265; fix JEI, Capes, Skin Layers and Puzzle

Fabric Loader:
- Port upstream Fabric Loader 0.19.1 -> 0.20.1 and report 0.20.1 to
  mods, so mods needing loader 0.19.5+ (Fabric Language Kotlin 1.14)
  load. Mixin 0.17.5, MixinExtras 0.5.5, tiny-remapper 0.15.0,
  mapping-io 0.9.1, class-tweaker 0.3.0, ASM 9.10.1.
- The loader presents itself as Vyne (name, icon, links, licence) and
  keeps the fabricloader id and version that Fabric mods depend on.

NeoForge:
- Default to NeoForge 21.1.265, matching the patch layer; an older
  version stored in .vyne/vyne.properties no longer pins it. JEI 19.70
  needs 21.1.238+.
- Find jar-in-jar libraries wherever META-INF/jarjar/metadata.json
  points (Skin Layers 3D keeps them in META-INF/jars/).
- End the construct phase with a ModLoadingException when a mod fails,
  so NeoForge writes the crash report its error screen opens.

Client:
- The Mods button replaces the Realms button on the title screen.
- The Mods screen opens Fabric mods' config screens through their
  modmenu entrypoint; Vyne's copy of Mod Menu's API is mounted only
  when Mod Menu is not installed.
- The loading overlay mixin uses @WrapOperation so splash-screen mods
  such as Puzzle can change the same calls.

Build:
- Inject the DeferredRegister and RegisterEvent bridges inside
  compileJava instead of separate tasks that rewrote its output, which
  made Gradle recompile mid-build and fail clean builds.
- Pass remapHooksJar's arguments through an argument provider (Gradle
  10 deprecation) and drop the ThreadDeath check (removed from Java).
- Every push to dev-1.21.1 builds, tests and publishes a GitHub
  pre-release.

readmeSummary: Vyne is an experimental Minecraft 1.21.1 modloader that runs NeoForge mods next to Fabric mods in the same game.
